meta.title: CaptionFitter: subtitles that fit the voice
meta.description: A macOS app that aligns your transcript to the voice in a video and turns it into subtitles. Works for spoken word and songs, entirely on your Mac.

hero.title: Subtitles that fit the voice
hero.subtitle: CaptionFitter aligns your transcript to the speech in a video and turns it into subtitles. It works for spoken word and songs, and everything stays on your Mac.
hero.requirements: Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon. Free and open source.

open.title: Open a video
open.body: Drop in a video or audio file to get started.

transcript.title: Add a transcript
transcript.body: Paste the text you already have, transcribe automatically, or search lyrics.

align.title: Align and export
align.body: Review each line, fix anything that needs it, and export SRT or a video with subtitles.

features.title: Everything you need to finish the subtitles

sources.title: Transcript sources
sources.body: Paste a transcript, transcribe automatically when you have none, or search lyrics on LRCLIB.

editor.title: Preview and subtitle editor
editor.body: Edit text, adjust timing, split and merge lines, and shift everything at once, with undo.

review.title: See what needs review
review.body: Lines that may be off are marked so you know where to look before you export.

style.title: Subtitle style
style.body: Choose the font, size, colors, outline, shadow, and position. The preview is what gets exported.

export.title: SRT or video with subtitles
export.body: Export a subtitle file, a new video with the subtitles burned in, or both.

models.title: On-device speech models
models.body: Download the speech model that suits your Mac, and delete the ones you don't need.

screenshots.title: A closer look
screenshots.main: The main window after aligning a transcript

privacy.title: Your video stays on your Mac
privacy.body: Alignment and export run entirely on your Mac, and your video and transcript are never uploaded. CaptionFitter only goes online to download speech models and to search lyrics when you ask it to.

footer.made: CaptionFitter is a native macOS app built with SwiftUI and WhisperKit.
